senses.meaning: Mối, mọt (côn trùng ăn gỗ, thường làm hại công trình)
examples: Termites can cause serious structural damage to wooden buildings.
We found a termite colony nesting in the basement.
The entire wooden floor had been quietly destroyed by termites.

senses.meaning: Sâu bọ, thú gây hại (chuột, cáo, rệp...); người đê hèn (nghĩa bóng, miệt thị)
examples: Farmers use traps and poison to control vermin that damage their crops.
The old warehouse was infested with vermin.
He called the corrupt officials 'vermin' in a heated speech.

note: Danh từ tập hợp — không dùng 'a vermin'. Nghĩa bóng mang tính miệt thị mạnh.

senses.meaning: Ngỗng (số nhiều bất quy tắc của 'goose')
examples: A flock of geese flew overhead in a perfect V formation.
The geese honked loudly as we walked past the pond.
Canada geese are a common sight in city parks during winter.

note: Số nhiều bất quy tắc của 'goose' → 'geese' (giống 'foot→feet', 'tooth→teeth').

examples: Grilled salmon is rich in omega-3 fatty acids.
Bears catch salmon in rivers during the spawning season.
Wild Atlantic salmon populations have declined dramatically.

note: Chú ý: 'l' câm — phát âm là /ˈsæmən/, không phải /ˈsælmən/.

examples: A bald eagle soared high above the mountain peaks.
The eagle swooped down and snatched the fish from the river.
The bald eagle is the national symbol of the United States.

senses.meaning: Con lươn (cá dài, trơn như rắn)
examples: Electric eels can generate powerful electric shocks to stun prey.
Unagi is a popular Japanese dish made from freshwater eel.
The eel slipped through the fisherman's hands.

note: 'As slippery as an eel' — thành ngữ chỉ người khó nắm bắt, lươn lẹo.

examples: Maggots were found in the poorly stored meat.
Maggots are sometimes used in modern medicine to clean infected wounds.
The compost bin was teeming with maggots.

senses.meaning: Gia súc (bò, trâu) — dùng chỉ cả đàn
examples: The rancher raised cattle on thousands of acres of land.
Thousands of cattle were killed in the prolonged drought.
Cattle are a major source of meat and dairy products in this region.

note: Danh từ tập hợp (plural noun). Không nói 'a cattle' — phải nói 'a head of cattle' hoặc 'a cow/bull'.

senses.meaning: Gạc, sừng hươu/nai (sừng phân nhánh, mọc lại hàng năm)
examples: The stag shook his impressive antlers at the rival male.
Antlers are shed and regrown each year — unlike horns.
He mounted a pair of antlers on the wall of his study.

note: 'Antler' khác với 'horn' (sừng bò, dê, tê giác): antler là sừng phân nhánh của hươu/nai, rụng và mọc lại mỗi năm; horn thì không rụng.

senses.meaning: Động vật ăn cỏ, ăn thực vật
examples: Cows, sheep, and deer are all herbivores.
Herbivores have flat teeth well suited for grinding plant material.
The study compared the digestive systems of herbivores and carnivores.
